projects.title: Holo’d
projects.details: A card-collecting game in the browser. A pack a day, foil that moves when you tilt, and a binder for everything you pull. The cards are my 2020 posters.

projects.title: Bord
projects.details: One library for everything you save. Share a post or a page from any app and it lands in one place, ready to file and find again. Designed by Adeoti, built by me.

projects.title: The Third Student
projects.details: A spoken language class. The teacher hands you the language in small pieces and you build real sentences out loud. Spanish, French and Indonesian so far.
